biw_news.title: Audi's Next A4 Delayed Until 2029 As VW's New EV Platform Falls Behind
biw_news.summary: Delays in Volkswagen Group's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) directly impact the implementation timeline for next-generation EV body architectures and unified chassis integration across brands. The setback forces extended production lifecycles for current structural platforms while postponing standardized cell-to-body manufacturing strategies.

biw_news.title: Gas Prices Are Up, And So Are EV Sales
biw_news.summary: Rising EV adoption continues to drive high-volume production of dedicated electric vehicle architectures, such as Tesla's Model Y structural battery body design. Increased market demand incentivizes further tooling investment in megacasting and multi-material joining technologies across body-in-white lines.

biw_news.title: For The First Time In Six Years, Ford Won't Win North American Truck Of The Year
biw_news.summary: The 2027 NACTOY truck shortlist highlights competition among body-on-frame and EV truck structural designs across competing OEM platforms. Key engineering differentiators include high-strength steel frame durability, cab crashworthiness performance, and lightweight multi-material box construction.
